newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore GDP rises 3.2 pct in Q3 of 1996.
newsitem.headline: Singapore GDP rises 3.2 pct in Q3 of 1996.

text.p: Singapore's gross domestic product (GDP) grew a real 3.2 percent in the third quarter of 1996 after rising by 7.5 percent in the second quarter, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said on Friday.
The figures confirmed what had already been announced in a speech on Tuesday.
Singapore's GDP rose 9.8 percent in the third quarter of 1995 while growth for the full year in 1995 was 8.8 percent.
The ministry said there has been a further slowdown in global electronics demand and non-electronics manufacturing industries have also been affected.
